_about: Public-domain Nicholas Murray (1802-1861), Presbyterian pastor of Elizabethtown, New Jersey, who wrote against Rome as 'Kirwan', for the Word Hoard: Notes concerning Elizabeth-town (1844), Bishop Hughes Confuted (1848), Letters to the Rt. Rev. John Hughes (1851), The Decline of Popery (1851), Romanism at Home (1852), Men and Things as I Saw Them in Europe (1853), Parish and Other Pencilings (1854), Preachers and Preaching (1860) and his Dying Legacy (1861), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 56 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
